coverage.summary: Rental units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance (rent-controlled units). Units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979 are exempt from the rent increase limits. Tenancies eligible for a rent increase under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act are also exempt, as are some tenancies whose rent is regulated by another government agency. All of these remain subject to the just-cause eviction rules.

result.notes: Changed requires_unknown_facts from true to false. The rule covers ordinary rental units built under a Certificate of Occupancy issued on or before 1979-06-13, so construction_cutoff already expresses the date limit. The Costa-Hawkins and government-regulated-rent exemptions cannot be checked by an address lookup, so they stay in unverifiable_exemptions. Set supersedes_state_rule to null because no document mentions Civ. Code § 1947.12 or any relationship between the local and state caps. For the same reason I removed the state-cap sentence from the summary. The construction cutoff and Certificate of Occupancy basis are confirmed by D079.
